description: This file defines an Android Activity named LaunchingAdjacentActivity that manages launching other activities with specific intent flags related to Android's multi-window and adjacent activity features.

classes.name: LaunchingAdjacentActivity
classes.description: An activity that demonstrates launching other activities with flags for multi-window « adjacent launching and task management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI, sets click listeners for buttons, and manages instance numbering.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on various buttons to launch different intents with specific flags.

methods.name: newAdjacentActivityIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch a new instance of LaunchingAdjacentActivity with main category and action.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current instance number to the instance state bundle.
